title: Title + kneeling warrior
visual: Paper stack on a wooden desk. Handwritten title "5 Mindset Rules" with a flourish. A warrior kneels in the rain, both hands on a sword planted in the mud; storm watercolor behind, broken spears on the field.
anim: Title writes on left to right; flourish draws; storm wash blooms; warrior is inked line by line, then watercolor bleeds in; rain falls the whole shot; head stays bowed.
sound: Low boom on the first frame, ambient pad starts, heartbeat pulse

title: Warrior rises
visual: Same scene. The warrior now stands, sword lowered in his right hand, cape behind.
anim: Cut to the standing pose, which rises 120px with an ease-out; a mud splash bursts at his feet.

title: Five scrolls
visual: Five rolled scrolls stacked down the page under the title.
anim: Scrolls unroll one by one (every 0.28s, scaling out from the centre); a violet glow wash blooms behind them.

title: Fire padlock "5"
visual: A golden padlock marked 5 sits on the bottom scroll, wrapped in flames.
anim: Padlock pops in (back ease); flames flicker; at 6.75s it swells and bursts into sparks; white flash.

title: Determined eyes
visual: Extreme close-up of a young man's face: stern brows, focused eyes, stubble, rain scratches.
anim: Slow push-in from 100% to 112%; rain streaks drift down; blue flash cuts to Rule 1.

title: Glowing 1
visual: Clean paper (desk gone). Title at top with underline. A big glowing blue "1" in blue flames.
anim: Title writes on, underline draws; the 1 pops in, flames flicker, then it shrinks away.

title: Helmeted bust
visual: Ink bust of an ancient soldier in a crested helmet and armour, lavender wash behind.
anim: Lines draw in order, washes fade in at 45%.

title: The mountain
visual: A young traveller in a tunic with a leather strap looks up at a tall hatched mountain; a staircase begins.
anim: Mountain draws, then the man, then the stairs; slow drift right.

title: One step at a time
visual: The traveller, full body, climbs the staircase toward the mountain.
anim: He steps up stair by stair with a walking bob.

title: No overnight success
visual: An "OVERNIGHT SUCCESS" ticket with a gold $ coin, ink splatter around it.
anim: Ticket pops in, shakes, then tears in two and the halves fly apart.

title: Summit
visual: A long brick staircase leads to the peak; a tiny figure stands on the summit; clouds and birds in a light-blue sky.
anim: Bricks draw bottom to top; camera eases out from 106% to 100%.

title: Electric 2
visual: Two-line title. A neon outline "2" crackling with lightning.
anim: Title lines write on; the 2 pops in; neon and lightning flicker.

title: General, hourglass, chessboard
visual: A general in a bicorne hat and uniform; an hourglass on the right; a perspective chessboard below.
anim: General draws, then the hourglass (sand starts falling and keeps falling to the end of the rule), then the board.

title: The patient move
visual: A hand reaches in from the right and moves a knight forward.
anim: Hand slides in, lifts and places the piece, then slides out.

title: Knight in the storm
visual: Storm clouds and lightning; enemy soldiers on the left; an armoured knight with shield and sword stands calm next to the hourglass; glowing blue arcs over the chess pieces.
anim: Storm wash in; enemies drift; lightning flickers; knight draws in; blue arcs trace across the board.

title: Blueprint 3
visual: Construction guides (circles, crosshair) and a hatched serif "3".
anim: Guides draw, then the 3 reveals top to bottom.

title: Laurel bust
visual: A marble emperor's bust with a laurel crown and toga, violet and ochre washes.
anim: Draws in, then slow push-in.

title: Fear shatters
visual: A black head silhouette with "FEAR of LOSING" written inside.
anim: At 30.5s the head breaks into glass-like shards that fly outward and fall.

title: Eyes ignite
visual: A young man's face, calm and stern.
anim: Slow push-in; at 31.85s both eyes flash white-blue with a horizontal lens flare.

title: Gladiator with trophy
visual: A gladiator with glowing eyes walks out of a smoky arena, golden trophy raised high, sword low; crowd and banners behind.
anim: Walks toward the camera (94% to 104%); dust rises.

title: Slash
visual: A single glowing blue slash on blank paper.
anim: Blue flash; slash grows from 10% to 100%, then fades.

title: Samurai
visual: A samurai with a topknot in a gi holds a katana diagonally.
anim: Draws in; the katana snaps up and a blue glint runs along the blade with a dotted cut arc.

title: One straight path
visual: Tangled roads fill the page; a profile face looks across; a blue laser beam cuts one straight road to a bright point.
anim: Roads draw; the beam reveals bottom to top with a star flare; the face moves closer.

title: Distractions, then fog
visual: Scribbles, #!?, spirals and comic bursts crowd the face; grey fog rolls in.
anim: Doodles pop in one by one and jitter; fog fades in, then lifts and takes them away.

title: Clear mind
visual: A large, calm front-facing face.
anim: Gentle settle from 104% to 100%.

title: Pen stroke
visual: A rough blue ballpoint stroke.
anim: Stroke draws in, then fades.

title: Stoic bust
visual: A marble bust of a bearded philosopher-emperor with curly hair and armour, indigo and ochre wash.
anim: Draws in, washes bleed.

title: The dark self
visual: The same bust, darkened and angry.
anim: Brightness drops to 42%; small shake.

title: Mask off
visual: A calm young man in a black bandhgala jacket, eyes closed, holding an angry theatre mask over his face.
anim: The mask slides away, rotates and fades.

title: Unshakable aura
visual: A blue aura surrounds him; arrows fly in from every side.
anim: Aura blooms and pulses; arrows hit the aura edge and bounce off, spinning and falling.

title: UNDEFEATABLE
visual: Huge bold black lettering across the top.
anim: Letters stamp down one at a time (220% to 100%) with flying debris.
sound: Riser + a hit on every letter

title: Subscribe
visual: A red SUBSCRIBE button and a pointing hand below him.
anim: Button pops in; the hand slides in and taps (button squashes to 92%); gold rays burst and slowly rotate; flash.
sound: Boom on the tap, music fades out
